The newly-appointed Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat today, marking the official assumption of his post as the Ambassador of the Kingdom of Spain to ASEAN. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda on his appointment and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s readiness to work closely with him and the Government of Spain to strengthen ASEAN-Spain relations, both through bilateral copperation and within the framework of the ASEAN-European Union Dialogue Partnership. Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda underscored Spain’s commitment to advancing cooperation with ASEAN in strategic sectors, such as trade and investment, sustainable infrastructure, energy transition, digital transformation, and connectivity. Secretary-General Dr. Kao further encouraged the Ambassador to engage with the diplomatic community in Jakarta, in particular with the Committee of Permanent Representatives to ASEAN (CPR). Both sides looked forward to Spain's accession to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) this year. Ambassador de Sicart Escoda also informed of Spain's intention to establish mechanisms for political dialogue and cooperation with ASEAN, in line with Spain's Strategy for the Asia-Pacific 2026–2029. Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda is the fifth Ambassador of Spain to ASEAN. He succeeds Ambassador Francisco Aguilera Aranda, who completed his tenure in July 2025.

VIDEO | Speaking in Lok Sabha, Union Home Minister Amit Shah says, “...The world recognises the strength and prestige of India’s democratic system. When allegations are made against the head of this House, questions are raised not only within the country but also globally about our democratic processes. That is why, generally, a no-confidence motion against the Speaker is rarely brought. Members can go to the Speaker’s chamber and discuss their concerns. The Speaker listens to members from both sides. However, a very strange situation has been created here, when members go to the chamber, an atmosphere is created as if the Speaker’s security itself is under threat. Nothing could be more unfortunate than this. What kind of system do they want? The position of the Speaker has been placed above party lines and is meant to function as a neutral mediator. Yet, questions are now being raised about the very person entrusted with this mediating role. I will explain later why such questions are being raised. For 75 years, both Houses of Parliament have strengthened the foundations of our democracy to great depths. Today, however, the Opposition has raised a serious question mark over it.” Video

T20 वर्ल्ड कप 2026 में पाकिस्तान टीम का सफर सुपर-8 स्टेज के बाद ही समाप्त हो गया था. इसके बाद खिलाड़ियों के खराब प्रदर्शन से गुस्साए मोहसिन नकवी ने सलमान अली आगा की अगुवाई वाली टीम पर तगड़ा जुर्माना लगाने का फैसला किया. दुनियाभर में PCB के इस निर्णय को लेकर चर्चा हो रही है. अब 2009 में पाकिस्तान को टी20 वर्ल्ड कप का खिताब जिताने वाले कप्तान यूनुस खान ने ऐसी चिंगारी लगाई है, जिससे मोहसिन नकवी और पाकिस्तान क्रिकेट बोर्ड तबाह हो सकता है. यूनुस खान ने पाकिस्तान खिलाड़ियों से इस फैसले के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन करने की सलाह दी है. उनके अनुसार टी20 वर्ल्ड कप में खराब प्रदर्शन के बाद खिलाड़ियों पर जुर्माना लगाना बेबुनियाद है. यूनुस के अलावा पूर्व खिलाड़ी राशिद लतीफ ने भी पीसीबी की जमकर आलोचना की. . . कई रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, मोहसिन नकवी की अगुवाई वाली पीसीबी ने सेमीफाइनल में न पहुंच पाने के कारण पाकिस्तान की पूरी टीम पर जुर्माना लगाया है. ईएसपीएनक्रिकइंफो के मुताबिक, टीम के सभी सदस्यों पर 50 लाख पाकिस्तानी रुपये (लगभग 18,000 अमेरिकी डॉलर) का जुर्माना लगाया गया है. इससे भी बुरी बात यह है कि यह फैसला भारत के खिलाफ पाकिस्तान की हार के बाद लिया गया, लेकिन एक शर्त के साथ, अगर टीम सेमीफाइनल में पहुंच जाती तो जुर्माना माफ कर दिया जाता. यूनुस खान ने कहा कि 2003 में भी पीसीबी द्वारा खिलाड़ियों पर जुर्माना लगाए जाने के मामले सामने आए थे, लेकिन खिलाड़ियों ने इसके खिलाफ आवाज उठाई और फैसले को पलटना पड़ा. पाकिस्तान के पूर्व कप्तान ने रिपोर्टर से बातचीत करते हुए कहा, ''क्या यह बात पक्की है? अगर पक्की है, तो यह सही नहीं है. पहले भी ऐसा ही एक मामला हुआ था. 2003 में, जब हम विश्व कप के बाद लौटे, राशिद लतीफ को कप्तान बनाया गया. उन्हें पीसीबी से संदेश मिला कि मैच फीस आधी कर दी जाएगी और भत्ते भी आधे कर दिए जाएंगे. एक-दो खिलाड़ियों ने इसका विरोध किया था. अब खिलाड़ियों को अपना रुख स्पष्ट करना होगा. अगर खिलाड़ी रुख स्पष्ट करते हैं, तो उन पर जुर्माना नहीं लगेगा.'' #PCB #PakistanCricket #MohsinNaqvi #PakistanNews

Like all young men in Iran, when Roni Aynsaz graduated from high school, he was required to serve in the military. That’s when Aynsaz’s story took its first Hollywood-esque turn. Today, he’s a successful 52-year-old businessman and the co-owner of the SCOOP shoe chain with dozens of stores across Israel. But before his conscription, young Aynsaz was a member of Tehran’s small Jewish community and, as such, destined for low-level positions, either in the military or in the civil service. Instead, Aynsaz made a decision that would change the course of his life and many others’: When presented with the form to declare his religion, he circled “Muslim” instead of “Jewish.” He soon found himself working in the Islamic Republic’s legal system under the Revolutionary Guards, often helping fellow Jews under investigation by removing their files. Thematic Sessions of the Regional Best Practices Seminar (South) under Aspirational Districts and Blocks Programme at NITI Aayog The Regional Best Practices Seminar (South) under the Aspirational Districts and Blocks Programme (ADP/ABP) was held in Vishakhapatnam, bringing together District Collectors, state officials and development practitioners from across southern India. The seminar featured three thematic technical sessions highlighting district-led interventions in Education and Skill Development; Health, Nutrition and Social Development; and Skill Development across Aspirational Districts and Blocks. Technical Session I on Education and Skill Development showcased innovative initiatives including the NIRMAN initiative from Alluri Sitarama Raju district, aimed at improving foundational learning outcomes, and the Rural Incubation Centre model from NTR district, which promotes innovation and entrepreneurship among rural youth. Technical Sessions II and III on Health, Nutrition and Skill Development highlighted impactful best practices such as the Anaemia Mukt initiative from Bidar district, addressing anaemia among women and children, and the Amma Rakshitha programme from Nirmal district, focused on improving maternal health outcomes. Additional innovative practices were also shared by the District Collector of Kurnool district, showcasing district-led approaches to strengthen youth skill development. In his concluding remarks, Shri Rohit Kumar, Additional Secretary & Mission Director – ADP/ABP, NITI Aayog, emphasised the importance of documenting and scaling best practices and encouraged districts to build on successful models while fostering cross-learning. The seminar concluded with key learnings and actionable insights, reaffirming the importance of peer learning and knowledge-sharing platforms in strengthening district-led innovation and accelerating transformation in India’s most underserved regions. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #AspirationalDistricts #AspirationalBlocks #BestPractices #ADP #ABP #DistrictTransformation #DataDrivenGovernance #LastMileDelivery #TransformingIndia

With India signing several FTAs, why is this the “Mother of all Deals”? How does it compare it with other FTAs like the India-UK FTA? 🔹 Is the deal WTO compatible? The newly-appointed Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat today, marking the official assumption of his post as the Ambassador of the Kingdom of Spain to ASEAN. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda on his appointment and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s readiness to work closely with him and the Government of Spain to strengthen ASEAN-Spain relations, both through bilateral copperation and within the framework of the ASEAN-European Union Dialogue Partnership. Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda underscored Spain’s commitment to advancing cooperation with ASEAN in strategic sectors, such as trade and investment, sustainable infrastructure, energy transition, digital transformation, and connectivity. Secretary-General Dr. Kao further encouraged the Ambassador to engage with the diplomatic community in Jakarta, in particular with the Committee of Permanent Representatives to ASEAN (CPR). Both sides looked forward to Spain's accession to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) this year. Ambassador de Sicart Escoda also informed of Spain's intention to establish mechanisms for political dialogue and cooperation with ASEAN, in line with Spain's Strategy for the Asia-Pacific 2026–2029. Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda is the fifth Ambassador of Spain to ASEAN. He succeeds Ambassador Francisco Aguilera Aranda, who completed his tenure in July 2025.

In Malaysia, the arrival of Ramadan is often marked by the comforting aroma of bubur lambuk simmering in large pots near mosques and community halls. Traditionally prepared in the late afternoon, bubur lambuk is distributed just before iftar, the breaking of the fast. Community members and volunteers gather to cook and share the dish, reflecting the spirit of togetherness and generosity that characterises Ramadan across the region. Made with rice, coconut milk, aromatic spices such as lemongrass, ginger, and coriander, and often beef or chicken, each region in Malaysia has its own variation of the recipe. A 10th March report in The Wall Street Journal says the fighting around the Strait of Hormuz has produced an unexpected outcome: Iran’s oil exports have surged above pre-war levels even while overall Gulf oil flows have collapsed. Before the war, Iran was exporting roughly 1.6 million barrels per day (b/d) of crude, and around 90% of those shipments were going to China, mainly to independent “teapot” refineries. According to tanker-tracking data cited by the Journal,Iran’s exports briefly jumped to about 3.66 million b/d in late February, more than double its normal export rate. At the same time, the total amount of oil moving through the Strait of Hormuz has collapsed. Normally about 20 million barrels per day—roughly one-fifth of global oil supply—passes through the strait. During the crisis, tanker traffic has fallen toaround 1.6 million b/d, roughly 20% of normal levels. The reason Iran’s exports have held up is structural. Most mainstream shipping companies and insurers have withdrawn from the area because of war risk. But Iran already relies heavily on a sanctions-evading “shadow fleet” of tankers, which continue to load oil from terminals such as Kharg Island and move shipments through the strait. Because other Gulf producers depend on conventional shipping and Western insurance, their exports have been disrupted far more severely. As a result, within the limited traffic that still moves through Hormuz,Iranian cargoes now represent a disproportionately large share. The report concludes that the crisis has created a paradox in global oil markets:overall Gulf exports have plunged, yet Iran—whose crude largely goes to China—has managed to increase shipments, exploiting its control over the geography of the strait and its existing shadow-fleet trade network.

Dumepensa ang samahan ng mga operator ng shipping lines sa bansa sa kanilang pagtataas ng presyo ng pamasahe sa mga barko matapos umalma ang local officials ng Mindoro Provinces na humiling pa sa MARINA na makialam at magsagawa ng imbestigasyon at ipahinto ang fare increase. Ayon kay Philippine Interisland Shipping Association o PISA Chairman at owner ng Philippine Archipelago Ferries Corpotation na operator ng Fastcat na si Christopher Pastrana, makatwiran lamang ang ipinatupad nilang fare increase dahil sa napakalaki na ng itinaas ng presyo ng fuel na malaking bahagi ng kanilang gastusin sa operasyon. “Before the Middle East crisis ang presyo lang po ng crude oil sa Mindoro at sa ibang part sa ibang lalawigan is about P53 to P55 per liter ngayon nasa P89, almost P90 na in span of one week, everyday tumataas, 80 percent of our cost as of today is already fuel, saan po natin kukunin yung pagtaas ng krudo?" sabi ni Pastrana. Nilinaw din ni Pastrana na bagama’t nagtaas sila ng pamasahe, iginiit niya na pasok pa rin ito sa kanilang publish rates na inaprubahan ng MARINA. Taong 2022 pa umano ang kanilang publish rates pero hindi umano nila ginamit ito dahil ang pinagbasehan nila ay ang market forces. Ayon kay Pastrana, kung nais aniyang mapababa ang pamasahe sa barko ay dapat na magpatupad din ang gobyerno ng mga hakbang na makakatulong sa kanila kagaya ng mga pagbabawas sa binabayarang tax at iba pang bayarin sa pantalan. Bilang hakbang sa pagtitipid sa pagkonsumo sa krudo, sinabi ni Pastrana na maraming shipping lines ang nagbawas na ng biyahe. Tiniyak naman ni Pastrana na mananatili pa rin ang mga discount na kanilang ipinatutupad alinsunod sa ipinatutupad ng batas. | via @Dennis_Datu Video

Потім навчався у Полтавському професійно-технічному училищі №31. У 2022 році хлопець одружився. У молодих батьків народилася донечка. Simple, hands-on activities using locally available materials made learning more engaging and practical. The Avenger-class mine countermeasure ships USS Devastator, USS Dextrous, USS Gladiator, and USS Sentry had their final ceremony in Bahrain in September 2025 and are now being transported back to the U.S. expected to be unloaded in Philadelphia tomorrow. They were based in the Persian Gulf for decades. Their mission was to detect and destroy naval mines and keep shipping lanes open, especially in the Strait of Hormuz. This role became especially critical after the 1980s Tanker War, when naval mines posed a major danger to traffic in the Gulf. With their retirement, the U.S. Navy no longer has dedicated Avenger-class minehunters in the Middle East. Only four of these ships remain active, and they are based in Japan. The Navy is now transitioning the mission to Littoral Combat Ships (LCS) equipped with mine countermeasure packages, including unmanned surface vessels, underwater drones, and airborne mine-hunting systems. The Modi government has relaxed FDI rules for countries that share borders with India. 👉The country that will benefit the most from this is CHINA. These restrictions were originally imposed in 2020 after the Chinese intrusion in Ladakh. Now the government is removing them. But the QUESTION is, what has changed? ❓Why are the rules being relaxed for China? ❓Why has India’s Finance Ministry allowed Chinese companies to take part in Indian government contracts again? ❓Why has India started giving visas to Chinese citizens more easily? ❓Why have India and China restarted direct passenger flights after a gap of five years? So the BIG QUESTION is: ⚠️ Why is the Modi government suddenly being so soft on China? Nothing has changed on the ground. 👉The situation in Ladakh has not returned to what it was before April 2020. 👉"Buffer zones" have been created in areas where Indian soldiers used to patrol earlier. 👉China is still sitting inside our territory. 👉 China continues to change maps and claim Indian land. 👉 Our Arunachal Pradesh citizen was detained and pressured to opt for a Chinese passport. 👉 China has even renamed our villages. 👉China has also built infrastructure in areas of Jammu and Kashmir. ❓After the sacrifice of our 20 brave soldiers in the Galwan Valley clash in 2020, what lesson has India taught China? 👉Instead, our dependence on China has increased. 👉Today, India’s trade with China is even bigger than India’s entire defence budget. ⚠️ Allowing Chinese investment in sensitive sectors like power grids and electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure could create serious risks in the future. The question the country must ASK is simple: ❓Are India’s strategic interests and the sacrifice of our brave soldiers being forgotten in the Modi government’s approach to China?

I performed poorly in school, not because im some big brain science brain man, but because the way schools work bothered me. I perform really well without structure. I am free flow. Schools put up educational standards in a vague generalization of "one size fits all", which is structured material and testing. Obviously many kids do good with this, but I never did. I have a hard time with surface level information and constantly ask "why" (to the annoyance of my teachers, probably) and would become bored and confused by not knowing "how something works" and just being presented with "this is just how it works". Again, this doesn't make me some super genius or whatever, but it's a reflection on different learning styles and how some people don't do too good with structured learning. It's also a reflection on how I personally think and how other people think. It is what it is, dawg. Thanks for coming to my TED talk.

Yeah, so basically the reason why nerds who work on computers are so weird about universities and stuff is because of the weird cultural shift that occurred when the internet really started booming Historically, universities were the only places people could get high quality information, labs, advanced literature, etc etc. They were higher education institutions. When the internet exploded, more and more information was dumped online in extreme volumes. Suddenly, in just a few decades, there is more information online than in universities. Universities no longer possess the elitism or secret knowledge or information they once had. Of course, for argument sake, some exceptions are still place, such as for healthcare. You can read all you want about surgery online, but you need to attend a university to get formal training. Anyway, when cybersecurity first popped up, universities didn't really have any material on it. They did, but it wasn't like it was online with forums and stuff (IRC, whatever) where information was pouring out every day. The problem universities faced was how fast information traveled. The information taught in universities is relatively old. In the age of the internet information is fast. Lightning fast. Everyday I see new malware papers being released. It would be virtually impossible for a university to keep up with this pace. So, the other thing is universities have structure and stuff. Being an internet nerd does not require structure and stuff. Many cybersecurity nerds thrived on being an autodidact and self exploring. When the autodidact nerds find a university nerd, there is a cultural divide whereas autodidact nerd thinks university nerd wasted their time and money and could have learned it themselves. University nerd sees autodidact nerd as someone who (probably) doesn't have an education or feels a bit elitist because they graduated from a university. The elitism they feel circles back to the historical stuff with universities, the secret knowledge, the alumni, etc. Ultimately, nerds can do whatever. Old heads and new head autodidact nerds will thrive and be driven by curiosity forever. Doing this requires immense self discipline and being infinitely hungry for information. University nerds may feel the same, but may feel lost without guidance and are more reliant on structure. University nerds can do well in our field as long as get their feet wet in university stuff, then continue self education outside of the university. Neither is wrong per say, just a different learning style and preferred method.

100 HAMBURGUESAS, UNA NOCHE DE RADIO Y UN DEBUT LEGENDARIO: LA HISTORIA DETRÁS DEL RITUAL SECRETO DE ELVIS QUE UNIÓ A MEMPHIS La primera emisión de "That’s All Right" en la radio de Memphis marcó el inicio de la carrera de Elvis Presley y originó una costumbre singular. El 5 de julio de 1954, tras grabar su primer sencillo en Sun Records, la canción fue difundida por Dewey Phillips en el programa "Red, Hot & Blue" de la emisora WHBQ. La reacción del público se tradujo en decenas de llamadas a la radio y la congregación de seguidores frente a la emisora. Esa noche, el entorno de Presley instauró una tradición que perduró: celebrar cada logro con un pedido nocturno de hamburguesas Krystal. Dewey Phillips ordenó hasta cien sliders para los fans reunidos fuera del estudio, convirtiendo el gesto en parte de la cultura del grupo. Así, la celebración con hamburguesas Krystal se consolidó como un ritual en los inicios del Rock & Roll y en la narrativa de los orígenes de Elvis Presley. 🔗 Infobae: infob.ae/4cGyJi5

DE RATONES A MOSCAS DE LA FRUTA: LOS MODELOS DIGITALES QUE CAMBIAN LA FORMA DE ESTUDIAR EL CEREBRO Científicos lograron digitalizar completamente la conectividad cerebral de una mosca de la fruta, reproduciendo su funcionamiento en una simulación informática capaz de imitar comportamientos originales. El modelo replica señales eléctricas y químicas, permitiendo observar acciones como la búsqueda y consumo virtual de alimento. La publicación de este modelo digital se realizó en acceso abierto, y otros laboratorios ya lo utilizan en investigaciones sobre enfermedades neurológicas. En paralelo, equipos de la Universidad de Oslo y consorcios europeos desarrollaron un atlas digital en 4D del cerebro de ratón, que permite visualizar su desarrollo desde el nacimiento hasta la adultez en tiempo real. Además, investigadores estadounidenses y europeos crearon atlas tridimensionales y biológicos que documentan la dinámica de tipos celulares y regiones cerebrales durante el desarrollo postnatal, facilitando el estudio comparativo y la investigación de trastornos neuropsiquiátricos. NI POR LA MAÑANA NI POR LA NOCHE: CUÁL ES EL MEJOR MOMENTO DEL DÍA PARA DUCHARSE, SEGÚN DERMATÓLOGOS Dermatólogos consultados sostienen que no existe un horario universal para ducharse, ya que la clave está en adaptar la rutina a cada persona. La regularidad y las necesidades individuales son factores determinantes para la higiene y la protección de la piel. El momento ideal depende de los hábitos, el tipo de piel y la rutina diaria. Los expertos subrayan que mantener una rutina diaria constante es más importante que el horario específico. Entre las recomendaciones, se destaca limitar el baño a entre cinco y diez minutos, usar agua tibia y aplicar crema hidratante luego de secarse. Las personas que practican ejercicio o se exponen a suciedad durante el día deben ducharse al finalizar esas actividades. Los especialistas recomiendan evitar jabones con fragancia y no usar esponjas de baño. La decisión sobre el horario de la ducha debe estar guiada por las preferencias personales y las necesidades dermatológicas. Infobae: infob.ae/4sF8hKx

Investing in rural women is a trillion-dollar opportunity. Women are central to rural economies - as farmers, entrepreneurs and leaders. Yet they continue to face significant structural barriers to land, finance and markets. Women make up 41% of the global agrifood workforce, contributing across the entire value chain from production to processing and marketing. Yet less than 15% of global landholders are women, limiting their ability to fully participate in and benefit from rural economic growth. Closing these gaps is not only a matter of equality, but also a powerful economic opportunity. Evidence shows that investing in rural women could raise incomes for 58 million people and strengthen resilience for 235 million more. At @IFAD, we invest where impact is greatest: at the #FirstMile of food systems. By expanding access to finance, technology, knowledge and markets, we are helping rural women strengthen livelihoods, build businesses and drive transformation across rural economies. On #InternationalWomensDay, the message is clear: investing in rural women strengthens food systems, economies and global resilience. BREAKING 🚨: The Earth's core confirmed to have 'reversed' its spin. Yes, the ground beneath your feet quietly changed direction and nobody told you. For decades, scientists assumed Earth’s inner core rotated slightly faster than the rest of the planet, spinning independently like a metal seed buried 5,000 kilometers below everything you’ve ever touched. A solid iron ball roughly the size of the Moon, suspended inside liquid outer core, operating on its own schedule. That assumption just collapsed. Seismic data picked up something that took years to confirm because the implications were too strange to rush. The inner core didn’t just slow down. It stopped. Then it began rotating the other way. What makes this genuinely unsettling is what the inner core’s rotation actually does. It generates and shapes Earth’s magnetic field, the invisible force field standing between all biological life on this planet and the full radiation output of the Sun. Animals navigate by it. Satellites depend on it. Your DNA has evolved inside it for hundreds of millions of years. The inner core rotates because of electromagnetic coupling with the liquid outer core and gravitational pulls from the mantle above it. When those forces shift enough to reverse a solid iron mass that weighs more than the entire Moon, something in that deep system changed significantly. And we felt none of it on the surface. No earthquake. No announcement. No signal. It happened in complete geological silence while humans were busy with everything else. The last confirmed slowdown period in the data aligns suspiciously close to measurable anomalies in surface magnetic field strength recorded over the past two decades. Compasses are already slightly less reliable than they were in 1900. The magnetic north pole has been accelerating its movement so fast that navigation systems have needed emergency recalibration ahead of schedule. A reversing inner core doesn’t cause a magnetic pole flip overnight. But it is a variable inside the same equation. The planet is a machine running processes humans have never directly observed. We read its behavior through tremors from distant earthquakes bouncing seismic waves through layers we cannot reach. Everything we know about the core comes from shadows and echoes. And those shadows just told us the engine changed gears. "Primero los pobres" Decía el viejo meado.. Pero los pobres de sus hijos y de sus cómplices. Se filtra lo que cobró Belinda, Galilea Montijo y los demás cantantes de la fiesta de XV en Tabasco. Lean un extracto de la columna de Salvador García Soto 👇 "Vaya escándalo el que generó en las redes sociales y en los medios el video de una fiesta de XV años de una jovencita originaria de Villahermosa, Tabasco. Y es que el nivel de lujo, excesos y ostentación que se derrochó en esa fiesta no se había visto ni siquiera en las celebraciones de los políticos y gobernantes, vaya ni siquiera en las fiestas de millonarios mexicanos. Fue tal el exceso para celebrar a una jovencita de nombre Mafer, que de inmediato los videos que compartieron en redes sociales sus propios padres y sus amigos que acudieron al evento, empezaron a generar reacciones de sorpresa, indignación y muchas preguntas sobre el origen de la fortuna del orgulloso padre, quien resultó ser un empresario tabasqueño, amigo del gobernador morenista, Javier May, y contratista favorito de Pemex en este y el pasado sexenio. Juan Carlos Guerrero Rojas es el nombre del padre de Mafer, quien mostró a los tabasqueños y a todo México la abundancia que lo ha favorecido en sus negocios con el gobierno. Y es que a la fiesta acudieron artistas, influencers, cantantes y toda una pléyade de estrellas que fueron contratados para felicitar a la niña, cantarle las mañanitas y amenizar su fiesta. El enlace para contratar, por ejemplo a Belinda y a Galilea Montijo, fue el maquillista Alfonso Whaitsman, quien se promociona en sus redes como “Celebrity make up artist”. Se dice que Galilea cobró entre 1 y 2 millones de pesos por hacer de anfitriona y conducir la ceremonia de los XV años, mientras que la cantante Belinda, solo por ir a cantarle las mañanitas a la quinceañera y sentarse un rato en la mesa con ella y sus padres, le habrían pagado más de 4 millones de pesos. Eso sí, el mismo padre de la quinceañera comentó que para que “Beli” aceptara venir desde España donde radica a cantarle a su hija las mañanitas al estilo de Marilyn Monroe, tuvo que ponerle un avión privado para que la llevara y la trajera. Del reguetonrero J. Balvin se dice que cobró entre 600 y 700 mil dólares por amenizar la fiesta, en tanto que Xavi, cantante de corridos tumbados, cobró arriba de 200 mil dólares, y ya para la tornafiesta, el grupo Matute cobró arriba de 100 mil dólares. Si a eso se le agrega toda la producción y decoración de la fiesta, que incluyó replicas exactas de tiendas Hermes, McDonalds y un mundo de pantallas, el cálculo estimado de lo que costaron los 15 años de Mafer a su padre es de hasta 2 millones de dólares. ¿Quién puede gastarse eso en una fiesta de XV años? No hay registro, ni siquiera en las celebraciones de políticos o millonarios, de algo que iguale los excesos que se vieron en la húmeda Villahermosa por un contratista de Pemex que se dice cercano al actual gobernador morenista May y al otro tabasqueño que dirigió Pemex en el sexenio pasado, Octavio Ramírez Oropeza. Se ve que mientras Pemex ya no genera mucha riqueza para los mexicanos y para el presupuesto, y más bien nos está costando miles de millones de pesos para pagar sus deudas y quebrantos, para los contratistas amigos del poder, Pemex sigue siendo una mina de oro, tanto que pueden derrochar millones de pesos para festejar una fiesta de su hija…"

POR QUÉ FORTALECER TENDONES Y LIGAMENTOS ES ESENCIAL PARA MOVERSE SIN DOLOR NI LIMITACIONES Las articulaciones y los tendones son componentes fundamentales del aparato locomotor. Su adecuado funcionamiento permite la movilidad y la estabilidad necesarias para realizar actividades cotidianas y deportivas. Diversos especialistas advierten que el cuidado de estos tejidos incide en la calidad de vida, la prevención de enfermedades crónicas y la recuperación tras la actividad física. La Organización Mundial de la Salud señala que los problemas en las articulaciones y las lesiones de tendones son una de las principales causas de dolor y discapacidad en personas de todas las edades. El fortalecimiento de estos tejidos, junto a hábitos saludables, contribuye a prolongar la capacidad funcional y reduce el riesgo de complicaciones asociadas al sedentarismo o al sobreuso. Los expertos recomiendan incorporar programas de ejercicio progresivos y consultar con un profesional de la salud antes de iniciar cualquier rutina, para maximizar los beneficios y prevenir lesiones. POR QUÉ LOS COLIBRÍES APARECEN EN PATIOS Y JARDINES La presencia de colibríes en patios, balcones y jardines urbanos indica un entorno saludable y con diversidad de flora nativa, según la National Audubon Society. Estas aves eligen espacios con flores ricas en néctar, arbustos y agua limpia. Su llegada también tiene un significado cultural y espiritual en diferentes partes del mundo, asociándose con esperanza, renovación y protección. El principal alimento de los colibríes es el néctar de flores, aunque también consumen pequeños insectos y arañas. Para atraerlos, se recomienda plantar especies autóctonas ricas en néctar y evitar pesticidas. La visita frecuente de estas aves revela la importancia de conservar la biodiversidad y promueve la polinización de plantas, simbolizando la armonía entre ser humano y naturaleza. 🔗 Infobae: infob.ae/4ddp0zV

LA MÚSICA FUERTE EN EL GIMNASIO APORTA MOTIVACIÓN EXTRA: LO QUE DESCUBRIÓ LA CIENCIA Un estudio realizado en Estados Unidos concluyó que bajar el volumen de la música durante las clases grupales en gimnasios no afecta la motivación ni el esfuerzo de quienes entrenan. Los investigadores midieron la percepción de esfuerzo, la preferencia de volumen y los síntomas auditivos en un grupo de participantes y observaron que la reducción del volumen no produjo cambios relevantes en la energía ni en la motivación. El equipo responsable del trabajo advirtió que el volumen alto de la música eleva el riesgo de daño auditivo y recomendó informar sobre estos riesgos, ofrecer protección y utilizar medidores de sonido en tiempo real en los gimnasios. Los especialistas señalaron que la música fuerte no suma motivación, pero sí puede afectar la salud auditiva. 🔗Infobae: infob.ae/4sCdqTs

The value of extreme precision Math Files (@Math_files) In 1798, a scientist effectively “weighed” the Earth — without leaving his laboratory. The English scientist Henry Cavendish designed an incredibly sensitive experiment. Inside a quiet wooden shed, he hung a horizontal rod from a very thin wire. Two small lead spheres were attached to the ends of the rod. Nearby, he placed two much larger lead balls. Because of gravity, the large spheres slightly pulled the smaller ones. The force was extremely tiny — so small that the rod twisted by only a minute fraction of a degree. Yet that tiny twist held a big secret. By carefully measuring this small movement, Cavendish determined the strength of the gravitational attraction between objects. From this, scientists could calculate the mass of the entire Earth. His estimate was remarkably close. Cavendish calculated Earth’s mass to be about 6 × 10²⁴ kilograms, while modern measurements give 5.97 × 10²⁴ kilograms. Sometimes the biggest discoveries come from measuring the smallest forces. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Math_files/status/2031348695921471489#m

The MESOB in Harar City is part of Ethiopia’s broader national initiative to modernize and integrate public service delivery through one-stop service centers. In Harar City, the MESOB platform currently brings together 8 institutions, operating through 24 service counters and providing 67 different public services to residents in a single location. This local implementation reflects the wider national effort to improve government efficiency, accessibility, and citizen satisfaction by reducing fragmentation across institutions and minimizing the time and cost required for people to obtain public services. Across the country, the MESOB approach is being expanded as part of the government’s commitment to digital transformation and coordinated service delivery, positioning integrated service centers as a key mechanism for strengthening public sector performance and enhancing the overall citizen experience. AlphaEvolve, an AI agent inspired by AlphaGo’s search methods, is discovering how to make computers run more efficiently. 💻 It recently was used to discover a novel way to multiply matrices — the core math powering nearly all modern AI. By optimizing code at its most basic level, we’re making entire ecosystems, from data centers to quantum computing, faster and more sustainable.

AlphaGo’s tech has moved from the game board to the hardest math on the planet. 🥈 Similar approaches helped AlphaProof, paired with AlphaGeometry, to become the first AI systems to earn silver at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO). 🥇 Recently, an advanced version of Gemini Deep Think went even further, achieving gold-medal performance at the 2025 IMO. We’re now applying this reasoning to the most complex, open-ended challenges across science and engineering.

What has this war done to US military competitiveness with China? In my view, it’s been devastating. Here’s why: 1. The US has consumed years worth of production of key missile interceptors and standoff weapons. These will take a lot of money and a lot of time to replenish. And at the end of those years of replenishment, the US will stand exactly where it stood at the beginning of this war. Meanwhile, China would have accumulated years of additional offensive SoWs, missiles and drones. The disparity between Chinese offense and American defense will grow significantly. 2. This war demonstrated the actual, practical interplay of Chinese and Russian high resolution orbital imagery and targeting assistance, with cheap Iranian drones. And it has been remarkably effective. These tactics and all the learning from their employment will be available to China with three distinct advantages. First, China has much greater industrial capacity to build drones. Second, they will have a tighter kill chain as imagery, targeting and kinetics would all be controlled by China. Third, the interplay of these tactics with the significantly more sophisticated Chinese offensive and defensive capabilities will make the threat orders of magnitude more potent. 3. To many observers, US equipment comes across as “not the future” in very distinct ways. Many Arab leaders are already asking whether the bases and equipment were supposed to protect them, or if they were supposed to protect the bases. This sentiment should not be discounted, and it will hurt exports and sales for sure. Who will benefit? China and Türkiye. The fact is that cheap Iranian drones blowing up $1.1B radars and THAAD subsystems on video cannot be ignored. Domestically-manufactured surface to air missiles shooting down $32M drones cannot be ignored. Neither can civilian trucks launching ballistic missiles produced en-masse. Is the “massively expensive, exquisite platform” approach really the future? 4. The Iranian strategy of Mosaic decentralized defense is very instructive for China and many others. It is human ingenuity overcoming the challenges of sophisticated EW, intel, and other adversary advantages. If US EW is superior, or if US intelligence is superior and can degrade command and control, how do you respond? This war has presented a practical template which I’m sure will be refined further. 5. Wearing my AI hat, this war has been a dataset goldmine for China. You’ve seen the public, mizar vision imagery. That’s impressive already. But what you haven’t seen is the Chinese military’s far more impressive multi-spectral imagery of live ops. And the electronic intelligence they have undoubtedly built while watching F-35s, F-22s and various US munitions - including new ones, such as the “stealthy” black Tomahawk - in action. This data isn’t just for human learning any more, it will also be collected to build automated (anomaly) detection and threat classification models. The structure of ops will also be broken down into discrete states and used to train predictive time series models. Much more to be said on this topic, but this suffices for now.

Opened the second Nuclear Energy Summit in Paris today with President @EmmanuelMacron. Hosted by 🇫🇷 @francediplo_EN in cooperation with the @IAEAorg, #NES2026 comes at a moment when nuclear energy is increasingly recognized as a tool of autonomy, industrial competitiveness and geopolitical resilience. When we speak about development, we speak about electrification, digitalization and artificial intelligence. In all these areas, we will need reliable and predictable answers. Nuclear energy is one of those answers. Reliable, low-carbon and independent of weather or fuel supply disruptions, nuclear power provides stable electricity systems and supports energy security. Its baseload reliability also enables the deployment of renewables and will be essential as electricity demand surges, including from the AI revolution. Today, around 60 countries are considering nuclear energy. But momentum alone is not enough: nuclear must be investible. Predictable policies, robust supply chains and accessible financing are essential to reduce costs and scale up its deployment, alongside greater standardization so the industry can move toward repeatable designs. We are making great progress. The @IAEAorg is working with international financial institutions to expand access to nuclear energy, including partnerships with the @WorldBank, @AgendaCAF, @TheOPECFund and @ADB_HQ. Nuclear power is not simply a nice-to-have, or a cleaner option. It is a strategic opportunity and we know it. As the global hub of expertise across the nuclear lifecycle, the @IAEAorg will continue supporting countries as they move to seize it.

ESCÁNER CEREBRAL REVELA CÓMO LA KETAMINA ACTÚA EN EL CEREBRO DE PACIENTES CON DEPRESIÓN Un equipo de científicos japoneses logró observar en tiempo real cómo la ketamina altera regiones específicas del cerebro en personas con depresión resistente al tratamiento. El estudio identificó modificaciones cuantificables en el receptor AMPA, asociadas a mejoras clínicas, y diferencias notorias entre pacientes con depresión resistente y voluntarios sanos. La investigación, realizada en 34 pacientes japoneses y 49 personas sanas como grupo de control, mostró que la ketamina genera variaciones medibles en la densidad de los receptores AMPA en regiones corticales y subcorticales. Los expertos señalan que la acción de la ketamina sobre este receptor solo se había evidenciado en modelos animales y destacan la necesidad de estudios adicionales, advirtiendo sobre el uso médico controlado debido a posibles efectos adversos. BREAKING: A record 39.3 million barrels of sanctioned crude are sitting on tankers off China's coast. The stockpile includes 30.2 million barrels from Iran, 5.6 million from Venezuela, and 3.5 million from Russia. This is up +454% from October and +17% from levels seen prior to the Iran war. ~77% of the crude is Iranian, but fresh offers have declined due to the ongoing war. Furthermore, ~66% of the tankers are anchored in the Yellow Sea, with the rest in the South China Sea, indicating that most of the supply is parked close to China’s major refining hubs. This floating stockpile acts as a buffer for China's private refiners, known as teapots, who have traditionally been the biggest buyers of discounted Iranian crude. China can afford to weather the storm for now.

He came. He saw. He left. That, in its entirety, is the sum total of Mr. Vanish Kumar's much-hyped Bengal visit. The CEC had no answers to the inconvenient questions surrounding the unfair and unlawful deletion of genuine voters from the final electoral rolls, nor could he clarify the fate of the 60 lakh voters arbitrarily placed “under adjudication.” He failed to provide any meaningful recourse or even outline a clear roadmap regarding the publication of supplementary lists and the inclusion of genuine citizens who have been wrongfully excluded. But as history has always shown, no one remains above the Constitution forever. But those who believe themselves to be above the Constitution inevitably face the long arm of the law. Today, expressing clear displeasure over the functioning of the Election Commission, the Supreme Court of India has issued decisive directions that Appellate Tribunals be constituted, comprising former Chief Justices of High Courts and former High Court judges, to hear appeals against exclusions; supplementary list be appended to the final voter list published on 28 February 2026; and technical disruptions in the ECI portal prior to March 7, 2026 be rectified immediately. This is nothing short of a stinging rebuke to the Bangla-Birodhi BJP-ECI nexus and a moral victory for the Maa, Mati, Manush of Bengal. In light of these landmark developments, I placed before Smt. Mamata Banerjee our humble appeal to conclude the dharna at Dharmatala, which she graciously accepted. But this is not the end. It is only the beginning. For the next 50 days, we will continue this battle on the streets, in the courts, in the Parliament, and among the people until the Delhi zamindars are uprooted from every single booth in Bengal and thrown out with precisely the contempt and fury they have so thoroughly earned. تیراندازی مرموز به قنسولگری آمریکا در تورنتو؛ دو مظنون تحت تعقیب پولیس در پیوند با گزارش‌های رسانه‌های کانادایی، تیراندازی به سوی قنسولگری ایالات متحده در شهر تورنتو کانادا به عنوان یک رویداد امنیت ملی تحت بررسی قرار گرفته است. پولیس تورنتو اعلام کرد که این رویداد صبح روز سه‌شنبه حدود ساعت ۵:۳۰ در مقابل ساختمان قنسولگری آمریکا در خیابان یونیورسیتی اتفاق افتاد. به گفته مقام‌های پولیس، یک موتر نوع هوندا CR-V سفید در نزدیکی ساختمان توقف کرد و دو نفر از آن پیاده شدند. این افراد با استفاده از یک سلاح کمری چندین فیر به سمت ساختمان قنسولگری انجام داده و سپس دوباره سوار موتر شده و از محل فرار کردند. پولیس در محل رویداد پوکه‌های مرمی و نشانه‌های اصابت گلوله به ساختمان را پیدا کرده است، اما گفته می‌شود که هیچ فردی در این حادثه زخمی نشده است. برخی جاده‌های اطراف قنسولگری نیز برای انجام تحقیقات بسته شده‌اند. پولیس تورنتو با همکاری پولیس فدرال کانادا (RCMP)، اداره امنیت اطلاعات کانادا (CSIS) و دیگر نهادهای امنیتی در حال بررسی این حادثه هستند. مقام‌های RCMP گفته‌اند که هنوز مشخص نیست این رویداد اقدام تروریستی بوده یا خیر و تحقیقات در روزها و هفته‌های آینده ادامه خواهد یافت. این حادثه در حالی رخ داده که طی روزهای اخیر چندین مورد تیراندازی نیز به سمت کنیسه‌های یهودیان در منطقه تورنتوی بزرگ گزارش شده است. مقام‌ها گفته‌اند که هنوز ارتباطی میان این رویدادها ثابت نشده، اما پولیس همه احتمالات را بررسی می‌کند.

L’énergie nucléaire nous donne ce dont notre époque a plus que jamais besoin : l’indépendance, la résilience face aux crises, la compétitivité et la capacité de tenir nos ambitions climatiques. Au moment où nos économies s’électrifient, où le numérique et l’intelligence artificielle transforment nos usages, où l’industrie a besoin de s’électrifier, la demande mondiale d’électricité progresse deux fois plus vite que durant la décennie passée. Face à cette montée des besoins, la France dispose d’un atout que beaucoup de nations nous envient : 57 réacteurs répartis sur 18 sites, soit le parc nucléaire le plus important au monde rapporté à notre population. Le nucléaire civil est aussi un levier décisif pour la décarbonation : le nucléaire c’est 12 grammes de CO2 par kilowattheure contre 490 pour le gaz et 820 pour le charbon ! À Belfort en 2022, j’avais fixé un cap clair : reprendre en main notre destin énergétique, en sortant de la dépendance aux énergies fossiles et en retrouvant notre souveraineté industrielle et énergétique. Nous y sommes et nous tenons ce cap. En 2025, nos centrales ont produit environ 370 térawattheures d’électricité, et la France a exporté plus de 90 térawattheures d’électricité décarbonée. Notre programme de construction de nouveaux réacteurs avance et nous accélérons. Au niveau européen, la neutralité technologique, de la standardisation, des financements à renforcer, des compétences et une vraie chaîne de valeur européenne. Au niveau mondial, des collaborations sur les enjeux de recherche et de développement, et un travail collectif sur la sûreté. Voilà notre ambition sur le nucléaire et ce que j’ai dit à Paris à tous les pays ce matin. Dans un monde plus instable, plus fragmenté, plus incertain, il est un choix de souveraineté, un choix de compétitivité, et une garantie pour l’avenir. Ce choix, la France l’a fait.

King Solomon died yesterday at two and a half months old. We loved him really well, and we don't have any regrets. We got nine days at home with him after 61 days in the NICU. Nine will never feel like enough, but we must accept what is given to us––we were never in control. Let's take stock of all God's mercies, how He worked through people: My OB, who heard my conviction about carrying Sol to term even with his disabilities, and supported it fully, with empathy and respect; the nurses in the Lenox Hill NICU, where he spent the majority of his time, who loved him so tenderly, like he was their own; his physical therapist, who saw extreme hope for him despite his disabilities, and tried to make it so; my mom, who put her own life on hold to come live in New York with us for the whole winter, to watch Zev and keep our household running; Zev, who wanted to wear matching pajamas with his brother each night he was home (and some of the nights Sol was in the NICU), who was eager to come to the hospital with us to play in the lobby even though he wasn't often allowed in the NICU, who chose not to be afraid of hospitals or tubes but to touch and kiss and snuggle his brother whenever he was able; @nwilliams030 and @rSanti97, who camped out at the hospital during Sol's final days so we would never feel alone, who watched Zev whenever our family had to dip back down to Texas; the people who covered us in prayer all over the country. Perhaps most of all, I'm grateful for my husband: He wasn't Catholic or pro-life when we met, but life experience has brought him to these beliefs. They ground us now; his faith is steadfast. He didn't leave Sol's side during those final, hardest days. He doesn't falter. Something tragic happened to our family, but we won't become permanently sad or dark; we really believe in God's promises. We're called to hope, no matter what, and the best we can do is serve our children with everything we've got. That's what we did, and in the process we got to glimpse the goodness of the Lord over and over again. Liz Wolfe (@LizWolfeReason) After 61 days in the NICU, our Solomon was finally released last week to come start life at home. Thank you for all of your prayers; it was the darkest, scariest, worst two months of my life. But God showed his grace to us in so many ways, and many people banded together to allow me to spend every single day with him in the NICU. We are so grateful to the nurses who loved him like their own; to his physical therapist who is helping him overcome & adapt to his disabilities; to the doctors who performed his surgery; to our priest who baptized him in the hospital; to the friends and family who packed lunches for us, and watched our toddler, and did our laundry, who prayed with and for us and still do. I am grateful in particular for my husband and my mom, who showed me Christlike grace throughout, and for our 3-year-old, who didn't let his joy become dampened by all this fear and sorrow—an example from which we could all stand to learn. "I remain confident of this," Psalm 27 reminds us. "I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living." The Lord's goodness has been shown to us every day of these 61. People sometimes denigrate Christians as just those seeking comfort, needing a story to tell themselves. But yes! We are comforted by the Lord. He shows up for us in all kinds of ways, when we're looking—and when we're not. And He looks after the scared and grieving mother, the sick and vulnerable child, the family in need. He did for us, many times over. And many of you did, too, through prayer and acts of kindness. Thank you. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/LizWolfeReason/status/2028839604934042061#m

BIMSTEC – सहकार्य, विकास आणि समृद्धीची नवी दिशा! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत आज विधान भवन, मुंबई येथे 'BIMSTEC यंग प्रोफेशनल्स एक्सचेंज प्रोग्राम'च्या पहिल्या आवृत्तीचे उदघाटन पार पडले. भारतासह BIMSTEC चे सदस्य देशांमध्ये विविध क्षेत्रांत कार्यरत असलेले युवा शिष्टमंडळ या कार्यक्रमासाठी महाराष्ट्रात आल्याबद्दल मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी आनंद व्यक्त केला. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली महाराष्ट्र शासनाने पायाभूत सुविधा आणि धोरणाधारित औद्योगिकीकरणावर आधारित विकासाचा मार्ग स्वीकारला आहे, त्यामुळे अर्थव्यवस्थेच्या वाढीसोबत रोजगाराच्या नव्या संधी निर्माण झाल्या आहेत. ॲडव्हान्स मॅन्युफॅक्चरिंग व फ्रंटियर टेक्नॉलॉजीच्या क्षेत्रात महाराष्ट्र आघाडीवर असून राज्यात ‘एज्यु सिटी’, ‘स्पोर्ट्स सिटी’, ‘मेडिसिटी’, ‘जीसीसी हब’ आणि ‘इनोव्हेशन सिटी’ अशा भविष्योन्मुख शहरांच्या उभारणीवर भर दिला जात आहे. तसेच 'ॲग्रीस्टॅक' व ‘महाविस्तार-एआय' या प्लॅटफॉर्म्सच्या माध्यमातून लाखो शेतकऱ्यांना त्यांच्या भाषेत पिके, हवामान आणि कीड-रोग व्यवस्थापनाबाबत मार्गदर्शन केले जात असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. स्पेस टेक्नॉलॉजी, एरोस्पेस आणि जिओस्पेशियल डेटा या क्षेत्रांत सहकार्यासाठी महाराष्ट्र सज्ज असून, नव्या तंत्रज्ञान क्षेत्रातील संधींचा लाभ घेण्यासाठी राज्यात मजबूत स्टार्टअप परिसंस्था आणि ‘फंड ऑफ फंड्स’सारखे उपक्रम राबविण्यात येत आहेत. जागतिक पुरवठा साखळीतील बदलांच्या पार्श्वभूमीवर BIMSTEC सारख्या प्रादेशिक सहकार्य मंचांचे महत्त्व वाढत आहे आणि त्यातून ज्ञानाची देवाणघेवाण व परस्पर पूरक विकासाला चालना मिळेल. तसेच पर्यटनाच्या क्षेत्रातही मोठ्या संधी असून जगभरातील पर्यटकांनी महाराष्ट्रात यावे, अशी अपेक्षा मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केली. तसेच प्रादेशिक क्रीडा स्पर्धा व पर्यटनाच्या माध्यमातून देशांमधील संवाद व सहकार्य अधिक दृढ होऊ शकते, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, ‘ब्रेन ड्रेन’ हा पूर्वी चिंतेचा विषय होता, मात्र आता परिस्थिती बदलत आहे. यासह अधिकाधिक सक्षम मानवी संसाधन निर्माण करण्यावर लक्ष देणे गरजेचे आहे. BIMSTEC देशांतील विद्यार्थ्यांना शिक्षणासाठी महाराष्ट्रात येण्याचे निमंत्रण देत भारतात उभारल्या जात असलेल्या जागतिक दर्जाच्या विद्यापीठांच्या कॅम्पसमुळे दर्जेदार शिक्षणाच्या नव्या संधी उपलब्ध होत असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले आणि युवा शिष्टमंडळाशी झालेल्या चर्चेबद्दल समाधान व्यक्त केले. यावेळी वरिष्ठ अधिकारी व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @narendramodi @Dev_Fadnavis @BimstecInDhaka #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Mumbai

▪️सरकार कुछ भी खोखले दावे कर ले मगर ज़मीनी हकीकत ये है कि देश के तमाम क्षेत्रों में गैस और तेल की किल्लत दिख रही है • मुंबई में तमाम होटल और रेस्टोरेंट इसलिए बंद हो रहे हैं क्योंकि कमर्शियल LPG सिलेंडर की कमी हो गई है • बेंगलुरू होटल एसोसिएशन ने कहा कि कमर्शियल गैस की सप्लाई रुकने से कारोबार बुरी तरह से प्रभावित हो रहा है • चेन्नई और हैदराबाद तक के कई रेस्टोरेंट्स मालिकों ने कहा कि अगर गैस सप्लाई जल्दी बहाल नहीं हुई तो खाना बनाने का काम बंद करना पड़ सकता है • पुणे में LPG की कमी से गैस शवदाह गृह अस्थायी रूप से बंद हो गया • गुजरात में गैस आधारित कई उद्योग बंद होने से लोग बेरोजगार हो गए हैं • यहां तक कि महाराष्ट्र के कुछ इलाको में पेट्रोल-डीजल के लिए लंबी-लंबी कतारें लगने की खबरें और तस्वीरें आ रही हैं • तेल कंपनियों ने राशनिंग शुरू कर दी है, डीलर्स और गैस एजेंसियों को गैस नहीं मिल रही हैं. तमाम ऐसे लोग जिन्होंने 10 दिन पहले गैस बुक की थी, उन्हें अभी तक गैस की डिलीवरी नहीं मिली है. लोग किल्लत की आशंका से चिंतित और परेशान हैं ▪️जो सरकार बार-बार कहती थी कि हम किसी भी संकट से निपटने के लिए तैयार हैं, उस सरकार का इस किल्लत से निपटने का क्या प्लान है? क्योंकि विपक्ष को गरियाने से, नेहरू जी को कोसने से काम नहीं चलेगा ▪️संकट की इस घड़ी में एपस्टीन के यार हरदीप पुरी किस बिल में छिप गए हैं, कहीं दिखाई क्यों नहीं दे रहे हैं? एपस्टीन का जो गैंग इस सरकार में भरा पड़ा है, वो कहां दुबका हुआ है? ▪️सरकार ने पहले कहा हमारे पास 75 दिन का इमरजेंसी स्टॉक है, फिर सरकार के मंत्री कहते हैं हमारे पास सिर्फ 25 दिन का स्टॉक है. कौन सही, कौन गलत ये भगवान ही जानता है ▪️भारत की इम्पोर्टेड कच्चे तेल पर निर्भरता • 2014: 77.6% • 2026: 88.6% • निर्भरता ⬆️ 14.2% ▪️भारत का वार्षिक घरेलू कच्चे तेल उत्पादन • 2014: 37.8 मिलियन मीट्रिक टन • 2026: 28 मिलियन मीट्रिक टन • उत्पादन ⬇️ 26% ▪️सरकार की नाकामी और संवेदनहीनता का ख़ामियाज़ा इस देश की मासूम जनता क्यों भुगते? Today at the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, I spoke on “The Americas in the New Geopolitics” and the responsibility of the @OAS_official in a time of global fragmentation. In an increasingly polarized world, the Americas must remain a zone of peace, guided by the principles of the OAS Charter and the Inter-American Democratic Charter. Peace and prosperity are the central aspirations of our Hemisphere. Our citizens want stability, opportunity, and a better future for their children. Development, democracy, human rights, and security are interconnected — and when prosperity expands, many of the pressures affecting migration, insecurity, and governance begin to ease. No country can confront today’s cross-border challenges alone. From security and migration to energy, food, and health, effective multilateral cooperation is essential. That is why we are strengthening the OAS, advancing institutional reforms, and mobilizing the broader Inter-American system to deliver more effectively for our member states. The Americas possess immense potential — vast resources, human capital, and five G20 members — yet we must deepen regional connectivity and cooperation to translate that strength into shared growth. The two leaders stressed the importance of de-escalation and emphasized the need to pursue dialogue and diplomacy in accordance with the principles of the United Nations Charter. IFAD, the European Union (#EU) and Hamkorbank, one of #Uzbekistan’s leading banks, today launched a landmark programme to boost rural entrepreneurship and expand financial inclusion. The programme, targeting nearly 4,000 remittance-receiving households and return migrants in #Uzbekistan, introduces a credit scoring model that allows remittances and returnees' savings to be recognized as proof of repayment capacity. The new scoring system helps overcome barriers that have kept many rural people out of the formal banking system, turning remittance income and savings into productive investments, sustainable businesses and resilient livelihoods for rural families. “Through this partnership with Hamkorbank, we are piloting an innovative solution within the Central Bank’s regulatory sandbox that can serve as a model not only for Uzbekistan, but for the wider region,” said Pedro De Vasconcelos, Manager of the Financing Facility for Remittances (@FFRemittances) at IFAD. "The European Union is proud to support efforts that make financial systems more inclusive and responsive to the realities of migrant families,” said Christos Marazopoulos, Head of Cooperation of the Delegation European Union Uzbekistan (@EU_Tashkent). “As one of Uzbekistan’s leading banks serving remittance clients, we see first-hand the potential of migrant families to become rural entrepreneurs if they are given access to the right financial tools,” said Hikmatullo Alikhonov, Chief Risk Officer, Deputy Chairman of the Management Board of Hamkorbank. Sometimes more. “Jmart, I’m going to [fill-in-the-blank city], where should I eat?” friends, colleagues and sometimes folks I barely know at all will ask. Often, the question in reference is about New Orleans, America’s greatest city and the town my wife, Betsy, and I call home. But just as frequently, it’s about somewhere else, where there’s a conference or wedding or news event. I’ve yet to meet the person who doesn’t want to find a good meal on the road. Which is why this week I’m starting “On the Road with Jonathan Martin.” After over 20 years of covering politics and visiting all 50 states along the way, I’ve eaten a lot of meals with politicians and those around them. Now I want to take you with me, have you watch and listen as I sit down and (quite literally) break bread at local joints with Democrats and Republicans alike. My vision: Anthony Bourdain meets “Lunch with the FT” meets the Almanac of American Politics. We’ll talk food, politics and place, delving into yesterday and tomorrow. It’s the great question at the heart of every political story, and it couldn’t be more relevant in America’s 250th year: How did we get here, and where are we going? We begin at Wright’s BBQ in Little Rock, Arkansas, where I had the ribs (great rub), brisket and mac and cheese last week with Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders. More on that below. I’m headed to California next, where I’ll dip into some Dungeness crab with California Gov. Gavin Newsom.

The Meeting of the High-level Organising Committee, constituted under the Chairmanship of the Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs Mr. Bala Nanda Sharma to organise the 12th Global Conference (GC) and International General Assembly (IGA) of the Non-Resident Nepali Association (NRNA), scheduled to be held from 14–16 March 2026, was convened at the Ministry today. Addressing the meeting, Foreign Minister Mr. Sharma highlighted the importance of the knowledge, skills and capital of Non-Resident Nepalis (NRNs) for Nepal’s development and expressed his best wishes for the successful organisation of the GC and IGA. Key highlights covering various aspects, including procedural matters related to the organisation of the GC and IGA, were presented and discussed during the meeting. The meeting was attended by the members of the Committee, including Hon. Member of the National Planning Commission Mrs. Suniti Shrestha Hada, Foreign Secretary Mr. Amrit Bahadur Rai, Secretary of the Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies Mr. Madhu Sudan Burlakoti, Secretary of the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Mr. Parashwar Dhungana, Presidents of @NrnaOfficial Mr. Badri KC and Mr. Mahesh Kumar Shrestha, among others.

Opened the second Nuclear Energy Summit in Paris today with President @EmmanuelMacron. Hosted by 🇫🇷 @francediplo_EN in cooperation with the @IAEAorg, #NES2026 comes at a moment when nuclear energy is increasingly recognized as a tool of autonomy, industrial competitiveness and geopolitical resilience. When we speak about development, we speak about electrification, digitalization and artificial intelligence. In all these areas, we will need reliable and predictable answers. Nuclear energy is one of those answers. Reliable, low-carbon and independent of weather or fuel supply disruptions, nuclear power provides stable electricity systems and supports energy security. Its baseload reliability also enables the deployment of renewables and will be essential as electricity demand surges, including from the AI revolution. Today, around 60 countries are considering nuclear energy. But momentum alone is not enough: nuclear must be investible. Predictable policies, robust supply chains and accessible financing are essential to reduce costs and scale up its deployment, alongside greater standardization so the industry can move toward repeatable designs. We are making great progress. The @IAEAorg is working with international financial institutions to expand access to nuclear energy, including partnerships with the @WorldBank, @AgendaCAF, @TheOPECFund and @ADB_HQ. Nuclear power is not simply a nice-to-have, or a cleaner option. It is a strategic opportunity and we know it. As the global hub of expertise across the nuclear lifecycle, the @IAEAorg will continue supporting countries as they move to seize it.

معاونیت اقتصادی ریاست‌الوزرا در خبرنامه‌ای نوشته که جلسه نوبتی کمیته سرمایه‌گذاری بین‌الوزارتی امروز سه‌شنبه، ۱۹ حوت، برگزار شده است. بر بنیاد خبرنامه، در این جلسه طرح بازسازی زمین‌های تخریب‌شده در کنار دریای آمو مورد بحث قرار گرفته و پس از ارزیابی همه‌جانبه قابل تایید دانسته شده است. بر اساس این طرح، نخست زمین‌های تخریب‌شده دوباره احیا می‌گردد و سپس در آن فارم‌های زراعتی و مالداری و همچنان کارخانه‌های پروسس ایجاد خواهد شد که در نتیجه آن مقدار زیادی محصولات تولید شده و برای هزاران تن فرصت‌های کاری فراهم می‌شود. در خبرنامه همچنین آمده است که طرح ایجاد یک کمپلکس تجارتی و رهایشی در ناحیه شانزدهم شهر کابل نیز مورد بحث قرار گرفته است که پس از گفت‌وگوها، به شاروالی کابل وظیفه سپرده شد تا ملکیت زمین و پلان آن را مشخص سازد. همچنان کمیته سرمایه‌گذاری بین‌الوزارتی درباره تعیین مکان‌های منظم برای موتر‌فروشی‌ها در شهر کابل نیز بحث کرده است. #طلوع‌نیوز

Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat today, marking the assumption of his post as the first Ambassador of the Republic of Malta to ASEAN. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Borg-Marks on his new role and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s readiness to work closely with him and the Government of Malta to explore opportunities for cooperation in areas of mutual interest, including in trade, investment, digital economy, connectivity, as well as people-to-people and business-to-business ties. With the assumption of office by Ambassador Borg-Marks, a total of 97 non-ASEAN countries have now accredited their Ambassadors to ASEAN.

Following the 5th March notification by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, there has been considerable confusion among suppliers and distributors, many of whom have stopped supplying commercial LPG cylinders to hotels, restaurants and food service establishments. We are already receiving reports of severe shortages from cities including Mumbai, Pune, Aurangabad and Nagpur, while similar disruptions are being reported in States such as Delhi, Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. If the situation does not improve within the next two days, nearly 50 per cent of hotels and restaurants in Mumbai may be forced to temporarily shut operations depending on the stock of cylinders they currently have. This will especially affect international tourists both, who are already here and those who will be visiting the country. NITI Aayog Convenes Regional Best Practices Seminar (South) under Aspirational District and Block Programme! The Regional Best Practices Seminar (South) under the Aspirational Districts and Blocks Programme (ADP/ABP) was conducted today at Visakhapatnam, bringing together District Collectors, State officials and development practitioners from across southern states to showcase innovative governance practices and accelerate district transformation. Shri Rohit Kumar, Additional Secretary & Mission Director, ADP/ABP, NITI Aayog, in his keynote address provided an overview of the Aspirational Districts and Blocks Programme and appreciated the sustained efforts of District administrations, Block officials and frontline functionaries in driving development outcomes on the ground. He emphasised that the programme should evolve into a Jan Andolan, with strong community participation and convergence across departments. He also noted that a majority of the programme indicators are nearing saturation in several districts and appreciated the strong performance of southern states under the ADP/ABP framework. Delivering the Special Address, Shri Anant Shankar, Joint Secretary, Planning Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh, highlighted the State’s focus on removing absolute poverty through targeted initiatives including the Zero Poverty Mission, guided by the vision of P4 – Public, Private, People Partnerships. He also noted the steady progress made by Andhra Pradesh and other southern states across key development indicators under the programme. The event also witnessed the unveiling of the Best Practices Compendium, showcasing impactful initiatives from districts across southern India that are improving outcomes in Education, Healthcare, Nutrition and Livelihoods. District Collectors and senior officers from Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands presented innovative district-level initiatives and participated in discussions on scaling best practices, strengthening convergence and improving last-mile service delivery. The seminar reaffirmed the importance of knowledge sharing, district-led innovation and collaborative governance in accelerating progress across Aspirational Districts and Blocks. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #AspirationalDistricts #AspirationalBlocks #BestPractices #ADP #ABP #DistrictTransformation #CooperativeFederalism #DataDrivenGovernance #TransformingIndia

This Women’s Day, Economic Policies for Women-Led Development (EPWD) is turning a new page — from embedding gender in macroeconomic discourse to shaping a gendered future of work and enabling a gender-inclusive structural transformation. Today, the story of women’s work in India remains complex. Even as participation rises, the deeper challenge is productive engagement — ensuring women have access not just to work, but to quality, higher-value economic opportunities. The structural story of women’s work in India reveals deep paradoxes: 🔹 41.7% Female Labour Force Participation Rate 🔹 Yet, 2/3rd of working women remain in agriculture 🔹 366 minutes daily spent on unpaid care work 🔹 60% of women outside the workforce cite domestic responsibilities Beyond participation: 🔹 Women sleep 2–2.5 hours less per week during prime working years 🔹 Spend ~10 hours less weekly on self-development The issue is no longer just whether women work — but what kind of work they are able to do. As we enter the next phase, EPWD will focus on understanding the structural barriers that shape women’s work, including the critical but often invisible role of time. We hope to contribute to a gender-inclusive future of work and support India’s journey toward #ViksitBharat 2047. #InternationalWomensDay #WomensEconomicParticipation #WomenAndWork #GenderEquality #FutureOfWork 🔗 View our work and new identity: icrier.org/epwd/ Video

(b): The ICAR has reported that four regional fisheries research centres are currently operating in Andhra Pradesh. ICAR has further indicated that there is no current proposal for establishing additional centres under ICAR in the State of Andhra Pradesh. (c): ICAR Fisheries Research Institutes have developed nationally relevant technologies that strengthen productivity, sustainable water use, species and system diversification, cost‑effective feeds, fish health management, genetic improvement, AMR mitigation, responsible fishing, and value addition. On March 7, the Shehbaz Sharif government raised the price of petrol and diesel by Rs 55 per litre. The government has justified this increase because it claims that since there was an expectation in the market that prices of diesel and petrol will rise at the next scheduled date of price setting (March 15), therefore there was hoarding by consumers, petrol pumps, dealers, OMCs, etc. Therefore a price increase was necessary to prevent hoarding and shortage. Many people, myself included, find this explanation reasonable. But what we have questioned is the incomprehensible decision to not raise the levy by Rs 55 on both petrol and diesel and collect additional revenues, but to raise the price of petrol and diesel to allow additional windfall profit to companies in the oil business. The government spokesmen reluctantly concede that they have allowed additional profit to the companies, but argue that the additional profit given to the companies will be reversed when international oil prices decrease. This is simply not true. First please note that the government sets fuel prices in Pakistan for a 15-day period, from the 1st and 15th of every month. The prices for March 1 to March 15 were set on Feb 28, based on the Platt’s average daily index for the period of Feb 15 to Feb 28. The companies buy their products knowing this implicit contract dates and formula. The average of this index represents or approximates the average cost of fuel bought by the oil companies from abroad to sell in Pakistan for the ensuing (March 1 to March 15) price period. To change the method in the middle of this implicit contract or set-price period (ie March 7) and to raise the companies prices is wrong and a huge windfall for them. The companies had already bought the product for this period prior to Feb 28. The companies, for instance, wouldn’t ever have accepted if the government had decreased their prices in the middle of this period if international prices were going down. If the government wanted to move from a 15-day set-price period to a 7-day set-price period, it should have done so at the end of the existing period, ie 15th of March. And to avert shortage it should have just raised its levy and not given a gift of Rs 19 billion from the struggling Pakistani awaam to oil companies. Second, the incorrect argument made by government is that the companies will lose money when the war ends and oil prices drop. This is not true. The prices in Pakistan don’t change based on international prices instantly. The prices for any period are determined by the average Platt price of the previous period. So that if the prices were to drop say the May 1, we will not reduce the price in Pakistan on May 1, but will use the Platt’s average for April 15 to April 30, or April 22 to April 30, depending on the period the government has decided. Of course the companies will always have some inventory gains when prices are increasing and losses when prices are decreasing. That is normal business. The companies were making normal inventory gains even before this windfall profit. As the price of oil goes from $60 to $120 per barrel, companies will make inventory gains. And as the price drops from $120 back to $60 per barrel, the companies will make inventory losses. And on average, if the price returns to where it was, the gains and losses will cancel out. So there was no reason to give an extra Rs 19 bn to the oil companies and oil dealers at the cost of the consumers. The government should have kept this money. But what they did was either sheer incompetence or wilful favouring of the oil lobby.

مایک والتز، نماینده‌ی امریکا در سازمان ملل متحد با اشاره به محدودیت‌های طالبان بر فعالیت‌های بشردوستانه و ممنوعیت ورود کارمندان زن به دفترهای سازمان ملل متحد، می‌گوید که این گروه بی‌تفاوتی خود را نسبت به رفاه مردم افغانستان ثابت کرده‌ است. او دیشب (دوشنبه، ۱۸ حوت) در نشست شورای امنیت سازمان ملل متحد گفت با گذشت چهار سال پس از تسلط دوباره‌ی طالبان بر افغانستان، وضعیت این کشور بسیار وخیم است. مایک والتز افزود: «طالبان از طریق سیاست‌های خود به‌طور مداوم رنج و سختی را بر مردم افغانستان تحمیل می‌کنند؛ دسترسی به ابتدایی‌ترین خدمات و حقوق را محدود ساخته و نقض حقوق بشر را ادامه می‌دهند، از جمله محدودیت‌های غیرقابل توجیه و حقیقتا نفرت‌انگیز بر حقوق زنان. این سیاست‌های سرکوبگرانه به یک فاجعه‌ی انسانی و بحران اقتصادی منجر شده است.» بیشتر بخوانید: storage.googleapis.com/quriu…

آدام بولر، نماینده‌ی ویژه‌ امریکا در امور گروگان‌ها می‌گوید که اگر طالبان شهروندان زندانی امریکا را آزاد نکنند، افغانستان به ونزوئلا و ایران بعدی تبدیل خواهد شد. او بامداد امروز (سه‌شنبه، ۱۹ حوت) با نشر پستی در ایکس گفته است که امریکا دیگر بازداشت شهروندانش را از سوی هیچ کشوری تحمل نخواهد کرد. نماینده‌ی ویژه‌ امریکا در امور گروگان‌ها گفته است که در حال حاضر سه شهروند امریکا در افغانستان زندانی هستند. بیشتر بخوانید: storage.googleapis.com/quriu…

বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার নামাজে জানাজায় নারীদের জন্য বিশেষ ব্যবস্থা ঢাকা, ৩০ ডিসেম্বর ২০২৫: বাংলাদেশ জাতীয়তাবাদী দল (বিএনপি)-এর চেয়ারপার্সন, তিনবারের সাবেক প্রধানমন্ত্রী ও গণতান্ত্রিক রাজনীতির শীর্ষ নেত্রী বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার ইন্তেকালে দেশব্যাপী গভীর শোকের আবহ বিরাজ করছে। তাঁর প্রতি শেষ শ্রদ্ধা জানাতে সর্বস্তরের মানুষের অংশগ্রহণ নিশ্চিত করতে প্রয়োজনীয় প্রস্তুতি গ্রহণ করা হয়েছে অন্তর্বর্তীকালীন সরকার। এই প্রেক্ষাপটে বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার নামাজে জানাজায় অংশগ্রহণ করতে ইচ্ছুক নারীদের জন্য বিশেষ ব্যবস্থা রাখা হয়েছে। জাতীয় সংসদ ভবনের দক্ষিণ প্লাজা ও মানিক মিয়া এভিনিউ এলাকায় নারীদের জন্য পৃথকভাবে এ বিশেষ ব্যবস্থা করা হয়েছে, যাতে তাঁরা সুশৃঙ্খল ও নিরাপদ পরিবেশে জানাজায় অংশ নিতে পারেন। উল্লেখ্য, বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার নামাজে জানাজা বাদ জোহর বেলা দুইটায় অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। জানাজায় অংশগ্রহণে আগ্রহী সকলকে নিরাপত্তাজনিত কারণে কোনো প্রকার ব্যাগ বহন না করার জন্য অনুরোধ জানানো হচ্ছে। বেগম খালেদা জিয়াকে শেষ বিদায় জানাতে আগত সকলের সার্বিক নিরাপত্তা ও শৃঙ্খলা নিশ্চিত করতে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষ প্রয়োজনীয় সব ধরনের ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করেছে।

The Directorate General of Shipping has issued DGS Circular No. 14 of 2026 (09.03.2026) advising Shipping Lines, Carriers and their Agents to promote transparency, fairness and predictability in the EXIM logistics ecosystem. The advisory follows representations from stakeholders regarding the levy of multiple ancillary charges perceived to be non-transparent and opportunistic, resulting in escalation of transaction costs in the logistics chain. Shipping Lines, Carriers and their Agents are advised to: 🔹 Refrain from predatory, non-transparent and opportunistic pricing practices, including levy of exorbitant charges taking undue advantage of prevailing geo-political issues. 🔹 Adhere to fair trade practices and avoid levy of charges that may give rise to disputes within the EXIM trade. 🔹 Ensure all applicable charges are communicated clearly and upfront to exporters, importers and other stakeholders. This local implementation reflects the wider national effort to improve government efficiency, accessibility, and citizen satisfaction by reducing fragmentation across institutions and minimizing the time and cost required for people to obtain public services. Across the country, the MESOB approach is being expanded as part of the government’s commitment to digital transformation and coordinated service delivery, positioning integrated service centers as a key mechanism for strengthening public sector performance and enhancing the overall citizen experience. Sumitomo Chemical declared force majeure yesterday, making it the fifth Asian chemical company in a single week. First Chandra Asri in Indonesia, then Yeochun NCC in South Korea. By March 5, Petrochemical Corporation of Singapore had declared force majeure on 1.1 million tons of ethylene capacity on Jurong Island. Aster followed a day later with its cracker running at half capacity. The root cause is the same for all five: naphtha, the feedstock these plants break down into the base chemicals behind plastics, rubber, and packaging. Asian steam crackers source most of their naphtha from the Middle East, and virtually all of it transits the Strait of Hormuz. When the Strait closed, all five lost their feedstock within days. Five force majeures in seven days. This is a massive disruption of the chemicals that hold the global economy together. Polymer prices are already up double digits. Everything downstream gets more expensive from here.

Pakistan Calls for a Bold, Practical and Reformed Commonwealth at the 26th Commonwealth Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting The 26th Commonwealth Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting (CFAMM) was held on 8 Mach 2026 at Lancaster House, #London, bringing together Foreign Ministers and senior representatives from across the Commonwealth, to set priorities ahead of CHOGM 2026 and explore transformative solutions for a stronger and more responsive Commonwealth. High Commissioner Dr. Mohammad Faisal @DrMFaisal represented Pakistan on behalf of Deputy Prime Minister / Foreign Minister Senator Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50, who could not participate because of the prevailing regional situation. In his remarks, the High Commissioner highlighted the urgent need for a more agile, inclusive and result-oriented Commonwealth in an increasingly complex global environment. He observed that the current global context was marked by fragmentation, geopolitical rivalries and increasing strain on traditional multilateral institutions. He noted that this moment presented both a challenge and an opportunity for the Commonwealth to reaffirm its relevance and collective purpose. At the same time, the High Commissioner cautioned against creation of new power centres within organisations. Emphasizing the importance of reforms, the High Commissioner stated that the Secretary General’s reform proposals merit serious and constructive engagement by member states. He underscored that Commonwealth Foreign Ministers and leaders must take a proactive role, not only in shaping institutional reforms but also in advancing meaningful cooperation among member states. Highlighting Pakistan’s perspective, the High Commissioner stressed that the Commonwealth must focus on practical outcomes that directly benefit its peoples. These included strengthening economic resilience, facilitating trade, promoting investment flows, addressing debt sustainability and advancing sustainable development. He called on the member states to seize this moment of global transition to reposition the Commonwealth as a credible platform for action, solidarity and shared prosperity.
